<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: JayaKrishna Arts -->

# DESIGN.md — JayaKrishna Arts

archetype: modern-advisory
rationale: The site has no images, no list of services and no contact details, only a name and one seven-word claim about forty years of practice, so it needs modern-advisory's flat brand-colour panels and large-set facts to make that claim read as a statement, with the terracotta standing in for the paint the site cannot show.
interaction_level: L1

personality: [assured, warm, unhurried, direct]

typography:
  display: "Manrope"
  body: "Manrope"
  scale: 1.333
  notes: |
    One face throughout, as the archetype asks.
    - Headings: Manrope 600, tracking -0.02em. The tagline runs from clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 8.5rem), and the single h2 sits at 2.25rem.
    - Body: Manrope 400 at 1.125rem, line-height 1.6, measure capped at 60ch.
    - Small text: only the eyebrow label above the form and the business name line in the panel. The eyebrow is 0.8125rem, uppercase, letter-spaced 0.14em, in muted.
    - No italics and no second family.

palette:
  primary: "#a8492b"
  secondary: "#f4eee4"
  accent: "#1e2233"
  ground: "#faf7f3"
  surface: "#f4eee4"
  ink: "#191c2a"
  muted: "#6a5a52"
  border: "#ddd3c6"
  application: |
    - Primary: the terracotta does the structural work as one large solid panel carrying the hero statement. Text on it is secondary (#f4eee4 on #a8492b is about 5:1, safe at any size).
    - Accent: navy carries the submit button and the focus rings. It never sits as text on primary, because #1e2233 on #a8492b is under 3:1.
    - Ground: a pale warm white with a breath of terracotta.
    - Surface: the secondary, used as the tint behind the enquiry band.
    - Ink: the navy accent pushed darker.
    - Muted: a warm umber that clears 5.5:1 on surface.
    - Why these neutrals: they read as pigment, linen and canvas from this artist's own materials, not as the framework's grey ramp.

composition:
  whitespace: generous
  photography: none
  card_usage: none
  mobile: |
    - The canvas panel goes full-width with a 1.25rem gutter.
    - Its 4:5 proportion relaxes to content height, with a minimum of 70vh.
    - The tagline drops to its clamp floor.
    - The form fields stack in one column at full width, and the button runs full-width.
    - The reCAPTCHA widget sits left-aligned and unscaled.

composition: The forty years are the whole case, and nothing else here is true enough to say. Set the name and "Four decades at the easel." at a size that fills the screen, then give the visitor the one honest way to reach the artist, and stop. There is no list, no gallery and no story to hold back, because none exists, and padding the page would only dilute the one claim.

sections:
  - id: hero
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: Make "Four decades at the easel." feel like a body of work rather than a slogan. The name and the tagline, exactly as written, carry the page on their own.
    spec: |
      - A single terracotta (#a8492b) panel proportioned like a stretched canvas, roughly 4:5. It sits off-centre to the left on the ground, with wide margins to the right.
      - An inset hairline in secondary runs 1.5rem inside the panel's edge, like the unprimed margin of a canvas. This is the site's one distinctive moment.
      - "JayaKrishna Arts" sits as a small 1rem/600 line at the panel's top-left.
      - "Four decades at the easel." is set at display size in secondary across the lower half, ragged-right, breaking over two or three lines.
      - Outside the panel, a single navy text link reads "Send an enquiry" and anchors to the contact section.
      - No image, no button cluster, no scroll cue and no invented subtitle.
  - id: contact
    priority: essential
    show: all
    intent: Be the only route to the artist, since no phone, email or address exists. A written enquiry should feel like a direct note to a person, not a ticket.
    spec: |
      - A full-width band on the surface tint.
      - Heading block: an eyebrow ("Enquiries") over one h2 line at 2.25rem, "Write to JayaKrishna Arts".
      - Beside the heading on desktop: name, email and a generous message textarea, with labels above the inputs.
      - Inputs: explicit #faf7f3 background, ink text, a muted placeholder and a border hairline.
      - After the fields: the lazily loaded reCAPTCHA v2 widget, then a navy submit button labelled "Send" with secondary text on it.
      - Behaviour: the form posts JSON to /api/v1/public/forms/submit with form_type "contact", reading its values from window.KORA_SITE_CONFIG. It shows a plain thank-you or a generic failure line inline.
      - Stacks to one column on mobile.
      - No list of contact details and no placeholder phone or address line.

avoid:
  - Stock or AI-generated artwork, paint-splash textures, brushstroke SVGs or palette clip-art standing in for the paintings the site does not have.
  - Invented content of any kind: a "40+" counter, a year founded, mediums, commissions, classes or a gallery of work. The tagline is the only claim, and it is rendered verbatim.
  - Words that assert facts not given, such as "studio", "our team" or "commissions welcome".
  - A centred hero over three "Portraits / Landscapes / Commissions" cards.
  - A nav with Services, Gallery or About items. The header carries only the name and an anchor to the enquiry band.
  - A serif display face or any serif nostalgia. The type stays Manrope.
  - Drop shadows on the panel or the form.
  - Navy text or icons placed on the terracotta panel.
  - A "Contact" block showing empty or placeholder phone, email or address lines.
  - A newsletter signup, since the business has nothing to send yet.
